text:
Sasha Lee: Heads-up — noticed a flurry of ambiguous errors for tenant fallback paths. Some clients see 500/opaque, others 429 depending on gateway. We need a consistent client-facing contract + telemetry tags so the console badges and alerts don't lie. Thoughts?

Maria Gomez: Agreed. We should avoid opaque 5xx unless it's truly internal. Proposal: 1) top-level "client_status" enum (OK, RETRYABLE, THROTTLED, FAILED), 2) optional "retry_hint_ms" when retryable, 3) "route_origin" tag to signal which routing variant served it. Keeps SDK behavior deterministic. :thumbsup:

Kevin Patel: Sounds sensible. Couple Qs: how do we represent fallbacks (primary->small-model) in the contract? And we must be careful not to leak raw capacity numbers in messages.

Sasha Lee: Good Q. My take: expose the effective outcome. Examples: FALLBACK_SUCCESS (OK w/ route_origin=small-model), FALLBACK_FAILED -> RETRYABLE or THROTTLED depending on cause. Keep "fail_reason" as a small enum (RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT, BACKEND_ERROR) rather than free text.

Maria Gomez: Console needs consistent telemetry too: add tags (client_status, route_origin, tenant_quota_bucket). That will let the dashboard surface degrades and correlate to rollouts without tracing every request.

Kevin Patel: Can you show a minimal example payload we can point SDKs at?

Sasha Lee: Sure — example error shape below (posted as-is for clarity):

```json
{
  "error": {
    "client_status": "THROTTLED",
    "subcode": "tenant_quota_exceeded",
    "retry_hint_ms": 120000,
    "route_origin": "region-us-west/priority-burst",
    "visible_message": "quota exceeded; try again later or contact support"
  }
}
```

Maria Gomez: Nice. A few implementation notes: SDK mapping rules — map RETRYABLE -> RetryableError; THROTTLED -> ThrottleError with a "retry_after" accessible; FAILED -> FatalError. Also add a compact i18n key like "visible_message_key" for console copywriters.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan applied to canary (eng-platform) at 2023-11-07T23:15Z — feature-flag: client-status-contract v1.

Maria Gomez: I'll draft the RFC and include a migration plan (SDK change, console copy keys, telemetry tags). Migration notes: default SDK behavior should be backward compatible — if server doesn't send client_status, map 5xx => FAILED, 429 => THROTTLED.

Kevin Patel: SGTM. I'll own rollout gating: enable by feature flag per-tenant and sample telemetry at 10% in week 1, ramp to 100% if no regressions.

Sasha Lee: One more ask from Console team: they want microcopy variants for each client_status + locale keys. Put that into the RFC.

Maria Gomez: Will do. Draft ETA EOD tomorrow.

Kevin Patel: Thanks — ping me for the feature-flag toggle once RFC is up.

Sasha Lee: Filing RFC path: rfc/1719975310-client-status-enum.md — will link when ready. Thanks everyone. :pray:
